'''Adwan Turoldine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Corellian Security Force]] with a prosthetic left arm. At one point, he was stationed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
